subject.title: Unhandled socket error in SSRF fetch wrapper can kill the gateway process (IPv6-only DNS + Happy Eyeballs)

question: Should maintainers repair/adopt the linked SSRF socket-error fix now, or wait for live IPv6-unreachable proof before accepting a security-boundary patch?
rationale: The source path and user report are credible, but the active fix PR touches SSRF DNS pinning and has blocking review concerns plus missing real behavior proof.

options.title: Repair the linked fix
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100433 so socket errors reject without weakening DNS pinning, with live or log proof if feasible.

options.title: Wait for live proof first
options.body: Require a Docker/Linux IPv6-unreachable reproduction or redacted logs before accepting any SSRF security-boundary implementation.
